feeds.title: The Fashion Retailer
feeds.description: The Fashion Retailer was founded in 2017 as a blog about news, insights, opinion essays, and conversations with leading fashion technology entrepreneurs and executives. It focuses on thoughts about the latest industry and customer trends, on describing different business models (e.g. fast fashion, luxury), key industry players (retailers and etailers), and how companies are facing the digital era.

feeds.title: Drapers
feeds.description: Drapers have been the leading authority on fashion retailing in the UK since 6 August 1887. We provide industry news, insightful analysis, commentary, and key data, as well as a growing portfolio of face-to-face networking opportunities. We strive to educate, inspire and connect newcomers and leaders alike in this innovative sector.

feeds.title: Nextail Blog
feeds.description: Browse the articles and research on our regularly-updated fashion retail tech blog for the latest news on industry trends and customer behavior. Nextail is a smart platform for retail merchandising. Developed by retail experts, it delivers agile data-driven decisions to meet increasing consumer demands.

feeds.title: Apparel Resources » Retail
feeds.description: News and analysis of apparel retail and fashion retail markets, retail destination, fashion retail hubs, retail centers, retail destination strategy, and more. Apparel Resources brings the two worlds of Buyers and Sellers in the Apparel and Textile industry together on a single platform through its vast pool of contemporary, insightful, and compelling information.

feeds.title: Retail Gazette » Fashion
feeds.description: Read about fashion retail, news, idea, updates, and more in this segment of Retail Gazette. The Retail Gazette publishes independently-sourced news stories, interviews, comments, and analyses relating to the UK's diverse retail industry. It aims to provide clear, concise, accurate, and balanced news reports and features about British retailers or international retailers trading in the UK.

feeds.title: Retail News Asia » Fashion
feeds.description: Retail News Asia is committed to providing both local and global retailers with the latest Fashion news throughout the Asian market. We, at Retail News Asia, have resources for everyone from independently owned business owners to online-only retailers, and major chains expanding their reach throughout the Asian market.

feeds.title: RetailDetail » Fashion
feeds.description: Read about retail fashion in this segment of RetailDetail. RetailDetail, the leading b2b-retail community in the Benelux, keeps retail professionals up-to-date by means of online & offline publications, retail events, inspiring retail hunts, and the unique co-creation platform retail hub, where retailers and their suppliers can experience the future of shopping.

feeds.title: Global Fashion Management Blog
feeds.description: Doctor Fashion will ask questions, do a diagnostic, ask for some tests & then deliver the prescription. Start growing today with confidence & security. GFM is an International Business of Fashion Expert focusing on Brand and Retail Management through Operations Improvements. Clients see us as their 'Chief Operating Officer'.
